description: Experience seamless language transcription with Vibe - your all-in-one solution for effortless audio and video transcription.
download-starting-description: The download will begin shortly. You can then find the installer in your Downloads folder.
title: Transcribe. on Your Own.
highlight-private-description: Transcription runs on your own machine. Audio never leaves your device, online or offline.
highlight-languages-description: Close to 100 languages and a full range of Whisper models, from tiny to large.
highlight-batch-description: Queue whole folders, export SRT, VTT, TXT, HTML or JSON, and drive it from the API.
closing-band-title: Free, open source, and yours to run.
post-download-step-open-installer: Open the installer from your Downloads folder.
post-download-step-launch: Launch Vibe and drop in an audio or video file.
feature-formats-description: Export transcripts as VTT, SRT, TXT, Markdown, JSON, CSV, DOCX, PDF or HTML, beside the recording or into a folder.
feature-url-description: Paste a link and Vibe downloads the audio with yt-dlp before transcribing it.
feature-realtime-description: Watch your transcription happen in real-time, with the option to cancel at any moment.
feature-summarize-description: Summarize transcripts with Claude, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or a local Ollama model.
feature-ollama-description: Do local AI analysis and batch summaries with Ollama
feature-audio-video-description: Supports audio and video formats like MP4, MKV, MOV, MP3, WAV, FLAC and more.
feature-devices-description: Record from your microphone or system audio, or merge both sides of a call into one transcript.
feature-gpu-description: Vibe is optimized to run on Nvidia/AMD/Apple GPUs!
feature-privacy-description: Transcription runs on your machine and the app sends no telemetry. Diagnostics leave only when you share them.
feature-customize-description: Pick and manage models in settings, and tune prompts and export options for the workflow you need.
which-mac: Pick the build for your Mac. Not sure? Apple menu → About This Mac shows the chip.
apple-silicon-hint: M1, M2, M3, M4 and newer
mock-transcript-1: Welcome back to the show — today we talk about local AI.
mock-transcript-2: Everything runs on your machine, so nothing leaves your laptop.
mock-transcript-3: Drop in a whole folder and it works through the queue on its own.
mock-transcript-4: Transcripts, subtitles and summaries, all offline.
mock-transcript-5: Speaker labels come from the audio itself, no cloud round trip.
mock-transcript-6: Click any line to fix a word, or a timestamp to hear it again.
mock-transcript-7: Then export to SRT, VTT, PDF or plain text in one click.
changelogDevFallback: No dev notes yet — showing the latest release.
feature-model-comparison-title: Compare models on your own audio
feature-model-comparison-description: Record a short clip or pick a file, run it through several installed models one after another, and compare the transcripts and timings side by side.
feature-update-channels-description: Release follows the stable line, Beta carries release candidates, and Dev delivers the newest builds. Check for updates whenever you want.
feature-meeting-browser-description: Open meeting links inside Vibe, get a record button on the call, and register Zoom, Teams and Webex links to open in the app instead of the browser.
feature-api-agents-description: Turn on the local API server, read its Swagger docs, and install a skill so Claude Code or Codex can transcribe from the terminal.
feature-phone-handoff-description: Pair a phone with a QR code, record on the go, and let this computer transcribe the audio. The relay is end-to-end encrypted.
feature-site-language-description: The website, docs and changelog are available in 15 languages, with a selector in the header and a shareable language link.
roadmap-description: What the next releases will bring. Each entry is an active OpenSpec change in the repository.
roadmap-note: These changes are planned, not shipped. The list is generated from the repository's unarchived OpenSpec proposals.
roadmap-empty: No planned changes are recorded yet.
